title: Satsuma
description: Reels that land, made by hand. A short-reel marketplace whose hero is a curved video wheel: ten cards on the inside of a cylinder drift, can be flung with momentum, and each card's width, lean and edge height come from one pure function of its position.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · SVG · Lenis

sections.title: A band
sections.summary: (aubergine, rounded top) that **slides over the pinned hero**: the hero is `position: sticky` and scales to 0.95 and dims as the band covers it (one rAF writes `--sa-out`). It holds a marquee of product categories (Sneakers · Skincare · Coffee · Houseplants · Headphones · Florals · Ceramics · Serums · Candles · Cookware) that pauses on hover, focus and off-screen.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: How it works
sections.summary: (`#how`): headline "Brief it. Match it. Peel off your reels." (the last words highlighted with a satsuma swash). Three apricot cards: 01 Send a brief (60 sec), 02 Meet your maker (24 h), 03 Peel off your reels (5 days). Each figure counts up (final value in a visually hidden span). Hand-drawn connector arrows between the cards draw as they reveal.

sections.title: Makers
sections.summary: (`#makers`): six tilt cards in a 3-column grid. Each has a looping scene (or a `Picture` once `maker-<id>` images exist), a "from $90 / reel" tag, a name, a craft and a city, a one-line style note, three stats (rating, reels shipped, turnaround) and a "Brief {first name}" link that pre-fills the form. Makers: Imani Okafor (sneakers, Lagos), Tove Lindqvist (skincare, Malmö), Mateo Ruiz (coffee, Valencia), Hana Sato (ceramics, Kyoto), Priya Nair (florals, Pune), Jonas Weber (audio gear, Leipzig).

sections.title: Packs
sections.summary: (`#packs`): "Buy reels by the segment." Three cards, each with a satsuma cut into as many wedges as it has reels (`segmentWedges()`, pure and tested): Quarter · 6 reels · $480 ($80 a reel, first reels in 5 days); **Half · 12 reels · $840 ($70 a reel, 7 days; the aubergine "Most picked" card)**; Whole · 24 reels · $1,440 ($60 a reel, 12 days). The wedges pop in one by one.

sections.title: Brief
sections.summary: (`#brief`, aubergine): "Tell us what to peel." with facts (24 h to a match, 9:16 vertical, $0 to brief) beside a paper form card: floating-label Brand name and Work email, a "What do you sell?" select, a radio row of the three packs, and an optional note (280 characters). Rules live in `forms/brief.ts` and are unit-tested: brand ≥ 2 characters, a valid email, a listed category and pack, note ≤ 280. Invalid fields shake once and their messages slide down; focus goes to the first error. Submit morphs to bouncing dots, then the form is replaced by a confirmation whose satsuma fills wedge by wedge, with a stable reference like `SA-H3K9`. **Never send a network request.**

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: (ink): the lockup, a line of copy, an email, two link columns and "A fictional brand for a landing-page template".
